messages.subject: 4D plot in ggplot
parts:
Dear all,

I want to create a 4D plot in ggplot and I would like your help.

The function is the following:

f(x,y,z)=z-max{x*y, 3(x+y)+1} whereas, x=2,...,19, y=2,...19, z=20,...,50

Thank you in advance for your help

Kostas

messages.author: 132d0542de930c5a
messages.subject: Re: 4D plot in ggplot
parts:
create a data frame with x y z - first x and y and last y
then derive the output of the function in a 4th column

then start experimenting ploting with ggplot pairs of dimensions
you can plot a 3rd dimension with color and or apply dimensionality reduction 4d to 3d
